subject.title: Android: Add message copy and text selection to chat screen

question: Which Android message actions should ship in core for this issue, and should maintainers adopt, replace, or close the conflicting open fork PR?
rationale: The central copy/select need is clear, but Share and Reply expand the Android chat product surface and the open implementation path is not cleanly mergeable.

options.title: Approve Copy and Select Copy
options.body: Land a refreshed target-repo implementation for whole-message copy plus selective text copy, leaving Share and Reply for separate product review.

options.title: Approve Full Action Sheet
options.body: Include Copy, Select Copy, Share, and Reply in one Android message menu and require owner review plus real device or emulator proof.

options.title: Defer Android Message Actions
options.body: Keep current code-block-only selection for now and close or park the linked implementation attempts as out of current scope.

recommendation.title: Approve Copy and Select Copy
recommendation.body: Land a refreshed target-repo implementation for whole-message copy plus selective text copy, leaving Share and Reply for separate product review.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle most recently touched and merged the active Android chat rendering path and is the strongest routing candidate in the inspected history.
